data.rationale: The proposal matches the core procedure (Careers, Openings, filter by country, team and time type, then search) with the right order and three of the four parameters, but it omits the final step of opening and acting on a job (such as Apply Now) and the action parameter, and its filter selection steps are vague, so an automation would stop at the search results.
